title: Spellforge Insectarium
description: A gothic fantasy scene shows a two-headed woman with long pink hair and black dress standing inside a large glass and chain display case labeled 'SPELLFORGE INSECTARIUM - GARDEN OF CHAINS'. The case contains pinned moths, spiders, a coiled snake in a jar, and other specimens. In the background, a dark mountainous landscape features a castle on a peak, a crescent moon, winding chains, and two small figures standing on a path.
